description: This line plot illustrates the validation performance of two models, SMOE and SimSMoE, measured by BPC (Bits Per Character), as a function of training steps. The x-axis represents "Training Steps" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50,000 (indicated as 50 x10³), with tick labels at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis represents "BPC" on a linear scale, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2. The plot displays two lines: the "SMoE Validating" line is black with a solid line style and 'x' markers, while the "SimSMoE Validating" line is magenta with a solid line style and '+' markers. Both lines begin at a high BPC value near 2.2 at 0 training steps and exhibit a rapid decline in BPC over the initial training steps. The "SMoE Validating" line starts at approximately 2.2 BPC and decreases to around 1.2 BPC by 50,000 steps. The "SimSMoE Validating" line starts at approximately 2.2 BPC and decreases to around 1.2 BPC by 50,000 steps. Both lines appear to converge and stabilize near a BPC value of 1.2 after approximately 20,000 training steps.
